extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 20da722d7ee5a1a0b66b37f2e138cff5e24c108e6dfe6c03b89f75fe57109826; the supplied identity is LCSC C7502712, MPN DSK26, manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The datasheet is a family sheet for DSK22 through DSK220. The exact DSK26 column was examined; the visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 is a grouped typical forward-voltage curve for DSK26-DSK28 at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. The points are direct digitizations of the supplied vector plot at stated voltage positions; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 is a grouped typical reverse-characteristics plot for DSK22-DSK26 at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC. The plotted reverse current is represented as positive magnitude in amperes; points are direct digitizations of the supplied vector curves with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The DSK26 electrical-characteristics rows give maximum VF = 0.70 V at IF = 2.0 A, maximum IR1 = 0.2 mA at VR = VDC = 60 V and Ta = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 20 mA at VR = VDC = 60 V and Ta = 100 degC, and typical CJ = 220 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 0.2 mA = 2e-4 A, 20 mA = 0.02 A, and 220 pF = 2.2e-10 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for DSK26 include VRRM = 60 V, VRMS = 42 V, VDC = 60 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A at 60 Hz sinewave with resistance load, IFSM = 50 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, and Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data.
The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification.
Schottky majority-carrier device: no minority-carrier storage, TT is zero by construction.
Reverse recovery is not modelled: TT is absent, so switching transients recover instantaneously.
Reverse breakdown is not modelled: BV is absent, so the model conducts only leakage above the rated VRRM.
No self-heating: junction temperature is fixed at TNOM. Thermal derating from the datasheet is not modelled.
Package parasitics (lead inductance, package capacitance) are not modelled.
Fitted at 25 degC only. Temperature coefficients XTI and EG are at physical defaults unless a temperature sweep was fitted.
Flicker noise is not modelled: KF and AF are at defaults (no noise data published).
